worlds.title: The Commons
worlds.summary: Your starting point: connect a participant, record practice, and build a traceable history.

worlds.title: Strategy Hall
worlds.summary: Board games and card duels for reasoning, planning, resource management, and adapting to an opponent.

boss_preview.title: The Strategist
boss_preview.description: A reserved set of positions and opponents checks generalization before a harder tier opens. Winning one familiar game is not enough.

worlds.title: Performance Stage
worlds.summary: Singing, rhythm play, and ensemble competitions that turn performances into useful feedback for voice and coordination.

boss_preview.title: The Live Set
boss_preview.description: An unseen performance set combines pitch, timing, articulation, and ensemble response. Listener preference is reported separately.

worlds.title: Locomotion Grounds
worlds.summary: Virtual bodies learn balance and walking. Separate, supervised physical trials measure whether those skills transfer.

boss_preview.title: The Terrain Gauntlet
boss_preview.description: Reserved terrain and disturbances test recovery and control. Passing a simulation never grants hardware permission.

worlds.title: Driving Circuit
worlds.summary: Practice perception, navigation, and control on virtual routes before separately qualified closed-course execution.

boss_preview.title: The Unfamiliar Route
boss_preview.description: A reserved route combines navigation and hazard response under a fixed vehicle and sensor configuration. Physical access remains separately authorized.

worlds.title: The Workshop
worlds.summary: Build, debug, research, and use tools. Connect challenges to independent tests and existing agent benchmarks.

boss_preview.title: The Integration Trial
boss_preview.description: Complete a new task while preserving existing behavior across a reserved regression suite and a fixed tool budget.
